brief: Global leaders navigate trade union changes, Iran tensions, and deadly wildfires; AI ethics and healthcare communication papers highlight human-machine interaction challenges.
news_summary: Australian PM praises resigning ACTU leaders as 'giants'; Trump in Michigan blames Biden for affordability, backs Hegseth amid Iran tension; European wildfires rage as heatwave looms.
papers_summary: Papers explore AI-driven virtual patients for breaking bad news and interactive model bending for artists, emphasizing practice-based explainability and asymmetric affective patterns.

zh.brief: 今日新闻聚焦香港前议员胡志伟在英国入境风波，以及中国女童基因编辑治疗死亡争议。学术方面，多篇论文探讨AI在医疗沟通、自闭症诊断及可视化工具中的应用。
zh.news_summary: 英国一度阻止因香港国安法被判刑的前议员胡志伟入境，后改变主意；中国女童基因编辑治疗死亡引发科学界关注。其他重要事件包括所罗门群岛金矿坍塌、柏林骄傲游行袭击、韩国快递员过劳问题。
zh.papers_summary: 多篇arXiv论文聚焦AI在医疗沟通训练（如告知坏消息的虚拟病人）、自闭症诊断辅助系统，以及面向化学家的分子图神经网络可视化分析工具。

todays_image.caption: Just as a painter mixes colors on a palette, politicians blend ambition and accountability while facing intense self-scrutiny.
todays_image.title: Self-Portrait with Palette
